metadata.description: Turn any research paper (PDF, LaTeX+bib, or arXiv id/URL) into a single-page interactive reader app.

plugins.name: paper2readerapp
plugins.description: Convert a paper into a self-contained interactive HTML reader: single-column render, never-cropped figures and tables, a pink-highlighter guided tour with margin sidenotes, clickable section summaries, citation popovers with full references, an audio-player navbar (Reset/Prev/Next/Back + progress), and MathJax.
